analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($780.00) vs SMA5/20/50 ($882.38/$929.23/$959.22) — Below short/mid-term moving averages, indicating a bearish trend.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($722.66/$511.52) — Above long-term moving averages, suggesting mid-to-long-term trend is still intact.
· 52-week position (55.2%) + Current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.1→37.9) — Entering oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histogram -17.5864→-17.5864) — Bearish convergence maintained, indicating reduced downward pressure.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $799.69) — Approaching lower band, potential for oversold conditions.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($652.21) — Based on Pivot S1 ($671.99), next support level if price declines.
· Swing resistance ($818.67) — Precedes Pivot R1 ($992.50), acting as resistance for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $776.49, 20-day low $776.49) — Sideways pattern, no trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.51x) — Below 5-day average, indicating subdued trading activity and lack of strong buying/selling conviction.
· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) — With RSI entering oversold and subdued volume, selling pressure is weakening. A wait-and-see approach is advised pending further indicator confirmation.
